title: Book
description: Book publication with author, ISBN, publisher, publication details, genre, pricing, and ratings. Used for bookstores, libraries, e-book platforms, and literary databases.

author.description: Full name of the book author

isbn.description: International Standard Book Number (ISBN-10 or ISBN-13)

genre.description: Book genre or category (e.g., Fiction, Non-Fiction, Mystery, Science Fiction, Biography)

published_date.description: Date when the book was first published

pages.description: Total number of pages in the book

language.description: Language code of the book content (e.g., en, es, fr)

price.description: Book price in the specified currency

currency.description: ISO currency code for the book price (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP)

rating.description: Average reader rating, typically on a scale of 1-5

cover.description: URL to the book cover image
